item.title: 'One more time': Biking Bishop embarks on final 4,800-mile mission for scholarships
item.description: The Biking Bishop is gearing up for his last ride, with plans to give out 2,500 scholarships to students.

item.title: Niagara Falls chocolatier transforms family business for New York’s growing adult-use market
item.description: All That Chocolate is Western New York’s first licensed woman-owned adult-use cannabis chocolate company, operating out of Niagara Falls and selling products in about 90 dispensaries across New York.

item.title: Plenty of ice this winter for Mayville Winterfest's ice castle
item.description: The Mayville community is embracing the cold weather with its annual Winter Fest, featuring an impressive ice castle.

item.title: Internal Email: Candlelight Cabinetry to resume operations week of February 23
item.description: 7 News has received multiple copies of an internal Candlelight Cabinetry email from owner Andrew Olsen that says he expects to 'catch up on all and continue operations the week of February 23rd.'
